validatorPruningCaveat: The local validator pruned the demo transaction slots before post-run verification (getTransaction returned null; firstAvailableBlock 447666383 > execution slots 447666005 and 447666052). Transaction checks therefore used the validator record captured server-side from http://127.0.0.1:8899 via getTransaction while the demo was executing, and the exact transaction bytes were reconstructed from that captured record and hashed. No post-run live re-query of these transactions succeeded.
